lessons_used: Redesigning the sign_in page for account sync clarity was helpful (+8.0% win) with accurate predictions, but sign_in hint changes showed no clear effect and predictions were too high.
Adding an interactive pet preview flow (new_flow) on the adoption page was helpful (+8.0% win), though predicted slightly high (+10.0%); other adoption page modifications showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps on the choose_path page hurt performance (-4.8% loss), where predictions (+5.0%) were far too high.
Layout and hint modifications on the choose_path page showed no clear effect, and predictions were consistently too high.
Finish page modifications (redesigns and hints) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Home page modifications (waiting info, new flows, and notification prompts) showed no clear effect across all tests.

candidates.title: Account Auth & Pet Storage Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign_in screen to prominently display account sync options alongside local versus cloud pet profile backup choices.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again, and sign_in redesigns previously delivered an 8% gain.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync & Secure Your Companion
sign_in.body: Choose your account method to ensure your pet data, personality traits, and custom creations are safely backed up.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Custom Pet Style Selector Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive rendering style selector components flow directly into photo uploading for custom pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes, and interactive adoption flows previously yielded +8% conversion.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Photo & Select Rendering Style
upload_photos.body: Pick your photo and select a visual art style to ensure your companion renders accurately on desktop.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a choice_cards cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate layout with a visual trait breakdown and confirm button to strengthen the companion confirmation step.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a sharp dropoff (64.5% conversion) with a median time of 89s, showing users hesitate before confirming.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Agreement

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0].asset' must be a bundled onboarding asset id (asset:...)

candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries about how to interact with, hide, or control pets after completing onboarding, and finish page completion drops to 64.8%.

decisions.title: Background Pet Preparation Audio Completion Notification

lessons_next: Redesigning the sign_in page for account sync clarity was helpful (+8.0% win) with accurate predictions, but hint and layout modifications showed no clear effect.

Adding an interactive pet preview flow (new_flow) on the adoption page was helpful (+8.0% win) despite predictions being slightly high (+10.0%), while other adoption modifications showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps on the choose_path page hurt performance (-4.8% loss) where predictions (+5.0%) were far too high; layout, hint, and copy changes showed no clear effect.

Redesigning the finish page for desktop placement celebration was highly helpful (+26.0% win) where predictions (-5.0%) were far too low, though an earlier finish redesign and hints showed no clear effect.
Audio completion notifications on the home page hurt performance (-6.3% loss), while other home page modifications (waiting info, new flows, and notification prompts) showed no clear effect.
